disagreements.text: Carbon plates aren't the whole story. My times dropped 2% in the shoes and another 2% the following year in the same pair, when the only thing that changed was going from 35 to 50 miles a week.
Nobody actually enjoys the long run. They enjoy having done it, which is a completely different thing, and the sport would be more honest if it said so.
